name: Albatross Koukairoku
source:
Aboard the Albatross is an odd captain and an equally crazy crew. With no map in hand, they sail to unknown islands, meet ghost ships and cross paths with giant monster fish. No one knows where they are heading… including the captain. But they still all stay together since there’s no other place for them.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/07/01/july-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
信天翁号上有一名古怪船长，以及一群同样疯狂的船员。他们手中没有地图，却驶向未知岛屿，邂逅幽灵船，还与巨型怪鱼狭路相逢。没有人知道目的地在哪里…就连船长也不知道。但众人仍然聚在一起，因为他们已无处可去。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/07/01/july-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
